intro.zh-TW: 透過分享碼 f65ra1 加入股市爆料同學會，這是 CMoney 推出的股票討論社群 App 與網站。

description.zh-TW:
股市爆料同學會是全曜財經資訊股份有限公司（CMoney）推出的股票討論社群，同時提供網站與 App，可以發文、提問與回答、查看即時報價與新聞，也有模擬交易與作者績效排行。App 可免費下載，部分功能需要在 App 內付費訂閱。

本頁的分享連結已包含分享碼 f65ra1；若註冊畫面有欄位要求輸入分享碼，請依原樣（含大小寫）輸入。平台提供的分享文案沒有提到邀請人或被邀請人的獎勵，所以本頁不列出優惠。

股市爆料同學會是資訊與討論服務，不是券商，社群貼文是使用者的個人意見，不構成投資建議。
description.en:
股市爆料同學會 is a stock-discussion community app and website operated by CMoney (全曜財經資訊股份有限公司). It offers user posts and Q&A, real-time quotes and news, simulated trading and author performance rankings. The app is free to download, and some features need a paid in-app subscription.

The share link on this page already contains share code f65ra1; if the sign-up screen asks for a share code, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization. The platform's share text does not mention any reward for the referrer or the invited friend, so no offer is listed here.

股市爆料同學會 is an information and discussion service, not a broker, and community posts are users' own opinions, not investment advice.

notes.zh-TW:
分享碼 f65ra1 已包含在連結中；若需手動輸入，請依原樣（含大小寫）輸入。分享文案沒有提到獎勵，本站也沒有找到官方的邀請獎勵說明，實際內容以 CMoney 官方公告為準。App 可免費下載，部分功能需要付費訂閱（App 內購買）。

股市爆料同學會是資訊與討論服務，不是券商，社群貼文是使用者的個人意見，不構成投資建議，投資決策與風險請自行評估。

CMoney 官方的防詐騙公告（2021 年發布、2022 年更新）說明，官方不會透過簡訊或通訊軟體推薦特定投資標的，也不會保證獲利；請提防第三方經營、推薦個股的通訊軟體群組。本頁只提供分享連結與分享碼，不提供個股推薦，也不保證獲利。
notes.en:
Share code f65ra1 is already part of the link; if you type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization. The share text does not mention a reward and no official referral reward description was found, so actual terms follow CMoney's official announcements. The app is free to download, and some features need a paid subscription (in-app purchase).

股市爆料同學會 is an information and discussion service, not a broker. Community posts are users' own opinions and are not investment advice; make your own investment decisions and assess the risks yourself.

CMoney's official anti-fraud notice (published in 2021, updated in 2022) says it does not recommend specific investments by text message or messaging apps and does not guarantee profits; beware of third-party messaging groups that push stock picks. This page only offers a share link and share code, and gives no stock picks or profit guarantees.
